title: Field Guide to Fable — Thariq Shihipar, Anthropic
talk_summary: An Anthropic engineer describes how to work with a new, more capable model class: shrink system prompts, give the model tools to build its own context, and use it to surface the human's 'unknowns' before and during work. The actionable core is a set of prompting/workflow patterns (blind-spot pass, interviews, references, implementation notes, quizzes) rather than infrastructure or cost techniques.

takeaways.technique: Shrink system prompts and drop constraining examples
takeaways.what_they_do: They cut 80% of the Claude Code system prompt, moving from 'do not do this' constraints and many examples toward context, because newer models are more imaginative than the examples given.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we recently removed 80% of the system prompt for Claude code

takeaways.what_they_do: Before starting unfamiliar work, ask the model to scan the relevant code/modules and enumerate the unknown-unknowns and gotchas so the human can write a better prompt/spec.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Can you do a blind spot pass to help me figure out my relevant unknown unknowns and help me prompt better

takeaways.what_they_do: Ask the model to interview the human with prioritized questions (e.g. 'prioritize questions that would change the architecture') to close remaining unknowns before implementation.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I'll ask Claude to interview me

takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of writing a long spec, pass an existing code sample, HTML mockup, or analogous implementation as the reference the model works from.
takeaways.evidence_quote: One of the best ways to give Claude a map is to give it another map

takeaways.what_they_do: While running, the agent logs every point where it hit an unknown and deviated from the plan, so the human can review where and why the work diverged.

takeaways.technique: Agent quizzes the author before merge
takeaways.what_they_do: Before creating/merging a PR, the model quizzes the human on what changed to verify they actually understand the work and stay in the loop.
takeaways.evidence_quote: get a Fable to quiz me about what happened
